title: Handling GST Summons under Section 70: Rights, Procedural Defense & Compliance
summary: Practical guidelines when receiving inquiry summons or DRC-01 show cause notices from DGGI.
body:
A summons under Section 70 of the CGST Act is a judicial inquiry proceeding. Non-appearance or furnishing false records can invite prosecution under Indian Penal Code provisions.

Defense Best Practices:
• Do not attend inquiries unprepared without complete books, e-way bills, and transport proof.
• Demand written questionnaires where complex accounting reconciliations are involved.
• Substantiate genuine transportation of goods via weighbridge slips, toll receipts, and GR notes.

Engage qualified statutory counsel immediately upon receipt of summons via our [Chamber Consultation Desk](/schedule).
